decision.explanation: The provided documents contain conflicting assertions regarding Lord Francis Hill's spouse. Document 1 (D1) presents a historical account stating he was married to Ishabel MacDougall, citing census data, parish registers, and historian testimony. Document 2 (D2) presents a narrative account where Lord Francis Hill is thinking of his wife, Janet Halyburton, Lady Dirletoun. As per the instruction to treat all sources as fallible and preserve distinct valid referents without collapsing them based on perceived authority, both names are retained as they represent distinct claims found in the source text.
